answer: Every agent identity buys into a fraud-insurance pool: a $60 deposit, pooled across the meadow of participants. A hollow shell cannot hide, because any peer proving an identity fake triggers payout. Step one, deposit and register. Step two, work under peer watch. Step three, proven fakes are purged, their deposit burned, the detector paid $200, and premiums triple for their cluster. Forging 10,000 fakes costs $600,000, hands hunters $2,000,000 in bounties, and 90 days of scrutiny. Like a haven funded by its own residents, the pool turns every fake into a payday for whoever exposes it.
